title: Disordered DNA-binding motif forms a modulation site for inhibiting the cancer immunotherapy target TREX1.
authors: Huang, Kuan-Wei; Yu Tsai, Chieh-; Wu, Chia-Yun; Lin, Wei-Cheng; Wu, Meng-Tzu; Hsu, Kai-Cheng; Yu Yang, Chen-; Chang, I-Ya; Liu, Helene Minyi; Chu, Jhih-Wei; Hsiao, Yu-Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体学和分子动力学模拟研究TREX1无序DNA结合基序的变构抑制机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但聚焦蛋白-DNA结合界面动态与抑制机理，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: In nucleic acid-binding proteins, short linear motifs (SLiMs)-an important subclass of intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs)-offer diverse opportunities for therapeutic intervention, yet their structural and functional roles remain largely elusive. Away from the active site of cancer immunotherapy target exonuclease TREX1, a novel modulation site formed by the intrinsically disordered alpha7-alpha8 loop is discovered by X-ray crystallography with newly identified inhibitors. Despite that the structure of alpha7-alpha8 loop upon binding-coupled disordered-to-ordered transition is inhibitor specific, a pattern of multivertex clamping is consistently observed. Mechanistically, the fuzzy TREX1-inhibitor interactions elucidated by structural analysis and molecular dynamics simulations reveal an ensemble of chemical-scale amphiphilic units for inhibitor moieties to anchor to. Functional assays confirm that our newly identified inhibitors disrupt the DNA binding and immunosuppressive activity of TREX1, establishing alpha7-alpha8 loop as a druggable SLiM. This work provides a first collection of atomic details for small-molecule inhibition involving a DNA-binding SLiM, and the mechanistic principles uncovered here may be generalized to targeting IDRs in cancer immunotherapy.
abstract_zh: 在核酸结合蛋白中，短线性基序（SLiMs）—— intrinsically disordered regions（IDRs）的一个重要亚类——为治疗干预提供了多样化的机会，但其结构和功能角色在很大程度上仍难以捉摸。在癌症免疫治疗靶点外切酶TREX1的活性位点之外，通过X射线晶体学结合新鉴定的抑制剂，发现了一个由 intrinsically disordered alpha7-alpha8 loop 形成的新型调节位点。尽管alpha7-alpha8 loop在结合耦合的无序到有序转变中的结构具有抑制剂特异性，但一致观察到多顶点钳制模式。机制上，通过结构分析和分子动力学模拟阐明的模糊TREX1-抑制剂相互作用揭示了一组化学尺度的两亲性单元，供抑制剂部分锚定。功能实验证实，我们新鉴定的抑制剂破坏了TREX1的DNA结合和免疫抑制活性，确立了alpha7-alpha8 loop作为可成药SLiM。这项工作为涉及DNA结合SLiM的小分子抑制提供了首批原子细节，且此处揭示的机制原理可能推广至癌症免疫治疗中靶向IDRs。
